desc: Develop and implement the O(n log n) segment-summary method for every relevant deleted negative value, ensuring correct concatenation of surviving blocks and non-empty subarrays.

Run sample and edge-case tests with explicit pass/fail results: one element, all equal values, all negative values, illegal deletion of every element, zero/nonnegative values, and no-deletion optimum.
Prove correctness of the segment-summary merge and the reduction that only negative values need be considered.
Analyze time and space complexity and finalize the Python solution.
